Idle panes, prompts and closed interrupt gates press nothing; Codex startup holds remain pending. Files are delivered into that ferrets attachments/ folder with paths in the message. An fyi is typed at once under its banner (v4 queue-off behavior); holding fyi to turn end and batching action sends wait on QueueingSends and the queue deliverer (after merge). Typed-but-unproven sends settle unaccounted and answer send_unconfirmed; Cancel, Enter and an explicit Retry work (Retry types a send again only when the daemon proved it absent; a send it cannot prove absent is refused with the reason). A pending Claude structured question is written by the hook-file watch, and every send, plain or now, is refused 409 send_refused with nothing typed or kept. A Codex request_user_input is found the same way, from the transcript's open call (the watch projects it through daemon/questions/lib/projection.ts into question.json), so it is refused the same way. Peer sends carry the Gate-proved sender and label on both transports; person and Warden port sends are bare, with the Warden ledgered as daemon. Interrupt cannot refuse kill_failed (Ferrets has no such state) and answers turn 0 (Ferrets keeps no turn count).

[own] GAP(conversation): the send path (#45) is composed (a turn document and its pointer for a send that today goes by file, the send tracker, native-file ledgering), with three declared limits. (1) A send to a STOPPED ferret revives it and carries the message as the relaunch's first turn (disposition revived; Ferrets' resume tells the send what it typed through the additive ResumeOptions.onCarried, and the row looks for that pointer and turn, daemon/host.ts reviveLocked). What is not carried is today's durable hold for an explicit revive (queued-for-revive): a relaunch Ferrets refuses, or one that carried nothing, takes the row back and the id starts over, with the refusal's sentence. The tracker's retype of a send whose pane has since gone is refused (no live agent) and settles as today's no-reviver case. (2) The tracker's evidence is the harness plugin's MASKED entries: a send is looked for by its words masked the same way (daemon/host.ts trackedLedger), and the harness's own input-queue records reach it through TranscriptEntry.data for Claude only (claude-code transcript.ts proof entries); Codex records no queue, so a Codex send queued mid-turn is proved by the pane or by the user record at the drain. (3) Claude input evidence without a native UUID is identified by its absolute byte offset; an external rewrite that shifts a previously claimed record can re-offer it and falsely confirm another matching send, an inherited v4 limit that append-style compaction does not trigger.
